en.title: AI Act, Annex VIII, Section C, point 5: the data protection impact assessment is referred to Article 26(8) instead of 26(9)
en.summary: Article 26(8) is about registration by deployers that are public authorities. The data protection impact assessment is in Article 26(9). The error is in all 24 versions. This has been pointed out publicly before.
en.impact: A public authority that registers a system is sent to the wrong paragraph for the assessment whose summary it submits.
en.correction: Replace Article 26(8) with Article 26(9) in Annex VIII, Section C, point 5.
